info.name: AlayaCare Accounting Accounts Progress Notes API
Get a list of progress notes by a client's AlayaCare ID

params.name: note_type
params.description: Filter on the note type category of the progress note

params.name: created_at
params.description:
Filter progress notes by creation date greater or equal than specified value.
Expected format is ISO 8601.
Ex: `2018-02-03T08:00:00-05:00`

params.name: created_by
params.description: Filter by the AlayaCare ID of the employee who created the progress note

params.name: id
params.description: Filter on the id of the progress note

params.name: include_textonly
params.description: Include notes content as simple text

items.docs: Get a list of progress notes by a client's AlayaCare ID

* A subset of HTML is accepted in the content. Supported HTML is based upon the following library: https://bleach.readthedocs.io/en/latest/ 
* `is_hidden` is optional, if omitted the progress note will be created with is_hidden set to `false`.
